postInstall.message:
push_notifications installed.

Wire up the init partial in your layout and (optionally) generate & store the
VAPID/sender key constants in one interactive step:

  pos-cli generate run modules/push_notifications/generators/install

Prefer to wire things up by hand? See the module README for the manual steps:
https://github.com/Platform-OS/pos-modules/blob/master/pos-module-push-notifications/README.md
